verdict.rationale: The Sonar chat completions response documents a `citations` array of URL strings alongside a `search_results` array, and the overview advertises built-in citations, so source URLs are returned for citing. The evidence never shows the fields inside `search_results`, so titles and published dates are unconfirmed, and nothing indicates whether the URLs are canonical. Missing for 10: documented title and published-date fields, evidence of canonical URL normalization, independent or hands-on corroboration of citation accuracy.
